faqs.a:
A capital improvements fund budget shall be prepared annually for a five-year period
               and will include all of the facilities described in section 2-69 hereof. The budget
               shall include the location and annual total estimated cost, together with the apportionment
               of the total estimated cost of each applicable year of the budget period. The budget
               will reflect the anticipated source of revenues for each facility including sources
               other than those available in the capital improvements fund. The capital improvements
               budget shall be adopted annually by resolution and appropriations shall be made by
               ordinance. Appropriations may be made without regard to the time of year and shall
               not expire until the project authorized thereby is complete and all costs thereof
               are paid or the project is cancelled.
(Code 1981, § 2-70; Ord. No. 2547, § 1, 8-15-1988)
Charter reference—
Budget procedure, § 10.2.
